# CG-RES-014: Response variant added

A oneOf/anyOf branch was added to a response schema (or an allOf constraint removed).

**Why it matters:** New variants were not guaranteed before.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Responses](./#res) |
| Direction | response |
| Detects | `schema.variantAdded`, `schema.variantRemoved` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> {where} may now return payloads of a new {composition} shape.
>
> Consumers that handle each variant explicitly may not handle the new one.
>
> **Fix:** Make sure consumers have a fallback for unknown variants.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: oneOf gains a variant

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      get:
-       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}}
+       responses: {'200': {description: ok, content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}, {type: boolean}]}}}}}
```

**Result:** Potentially breaking, medium. GET /x: response 200 (application/json) may now return payloads of a new oneOf shape.

### Does not fire: request direction

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}]}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{type: string}, {type: integer}, {type: boolean}]}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
